correctness.rationale: The angle formula gives exact contraction on each switch. The uniform row words map bijectively to iid Bernoulli switch words. The normalized squared error is a mean-one martingale, tends to zero by the strong law, and has bounded stopped values; bounded optional stopping yields the exact hitting-payoff identity. All-up and one-down-then-up positive-probability paths prove strictness unless both log-level and log-jump ratio are integral, and lattice skip-free crossing proves sufficiency. Strict convexity gives unique algebraic angles. The extracted standard-library verifier independently reproduces exact d=3 identities and finite paths; it is supportive, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source asks for practical time-uniform Kaczmarz error confidence bounds. This work resolves their reciprocal-confidence sharpness within an analytically natural full-rank two-row instance at its exact conditional-mean rate, classifies all equality geometries/levels, and supplies a full stepwise all-time crossing law. It is a reusable exact benchmark for assessing confidence-factor improvements; it expressly does not claim sharpness of the source’s more conservative general operator-norm-rate bound.
